baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 3 predicates an established state, while word 4 (root ر ص د) names its operative form.
baseline_models.mechanism: Temporal predication makes Jahannam an established presence, and the watching branch makes that presence active: it waits, guards, and can spring upon what enters its range.

activation_trace.role: Being or occurrence in time makes the predicated condition established rather than hypothetical.
Watching, waiting, guarding, and ambush supply the active function of the established condition.

changed_reading.before: Jahannam was simply present as a destination.
changed_reading.after: Jahannam was already functioning as a guarded ambush that waits for an entrant.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal force of word 3 combines with the preparation branch of root ر ص د in word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can denote not only something watching but something prepared and set aside in advance, including for a person, liability, or recompense.

activation_trace.role: Temporal presence places the preparation before the encounter narrated around it.
Preparing or setting something aside supplies advance assignment to a recipient or recompense.

changed_reading.before: The verse identifies an available place of punishment.
changed_reading.after: The verse identifies a consequence already earmarked before its recipients arrive.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 4 is a place-form from root ر ص د; the place and position branch of root ك و ن in word 3 reinforces spatial stationing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two focus roots spatialize the clause as a post located on a traversed way, where movement is not merely observed but intercepted by a prepared trap.

activation_trace.role: Place, position, and station supply a spatially fixed role, though this branch is form-distant from the finite verb.
A lookout post, path, or prepared trapping place turns the predicate into route infrastructure.

changed_reading.after: Jahannam is a stationed trap on a route, encountered through movement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The less expected surety branch of root ك و ن in word 3 meets the assignment-for-debt branch of root ر ص د in word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Read together at branch level, the clause can personify Jahannam as the standing guarantee that an outstanding liability will be met, rather than as scenery alone.

activation_trace.role: Suretyship and undertaking responsibility supply the guarantor role, with substantial form-distance from the surface verb.
Advance assignment for a debt or recompense supplies the liability that the guarantor enforces.

changed_reading.before: Jahannam is an impersonal prepared punishment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, Jahannam stands as the guarantee that a pending liability cannot lapse.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first presents habitable terrain as prepared and anchored, then opens the upper boundary and removes the mountains into mirage. Against that reversal, the focus route-post becomes the operative checkpoint that remains when ordinary topography no longer guides movement.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies a lookout post or trapping place situated on a path.
Preparation and leveling establish the initial world as usable terrain.
Stake-like upright stability supplies the anchoring condition that is later reversed.
The opening of what was closed makes a formerly bounded region traversable.
An entryway supplies explicit route topology to the opened boundary.
Removal and displacement cancel the mountains' former stationary function.
A water-like mirage makes the former landmark visually present but materially unreliable.

structural_cues: The sequence stabilizes the inhabited world in 78:6-7, then opens and removes its familiar boundaries in 78:19-20 immediately before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prepared terrain, anchoring, openings, displacement, mirage, and a focus path-post. I infer that the post becomes the remaining operative route control after the terrain reverses. A live alternative is that 78:19-20 only stage cosmic collapse and do not spatially specify the focus.

changed_reading.before: The route trap sits within ordinary geography.
changed_reading.after: The route trap functions as a checkpoint precisely when ordinary geography has opened, moved, and become unreliable.

context_deltas.mechanism: A bounded day, juridical separation, fixed appointment, arrival, and grouped movement turn the waiting place into a timed sorting station for incoming collectives.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predication lets the focus station stand within an appointed sequence.
A path-side lookout or trap supplies the station through which arrivals can be sorted.
A bounded day supplies the event's temporal container.
Judgment that distinguishes right from wrong supplies the sorting function.
A fixed appointment makes the waiting purposeful and scheduled.
Coming and arrival provide movement toward the station.
Human groups make the arrivals collective units available for separation.

structural_cues: 78:17 names the appointed separation, 78:18 stages grouped arrival, and 78:21 supplies the waiting station after the route opens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appointment, judicial separation, arrival in groups, and a focus path-post. I infer that interception at the post operationalizes the separation. A live alternative is that sorting occurs before the arrivals reach Jahannam, leaving the focus only as their later destination.

changed_reading.before: Jahannam is an indefinitely waiting ambush.
changed_reading.after: Jahannam is a scheduled sorting checkpoint activated at the appointed collective arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: The clause immediately after the focus supplies both a class defined by crossing limits and a return-place. The prepared trap is therefore not generic: it is reserved as the point to which that trajectory comes back.

activation_trace.role: Advance preparation or assignment supplies reservation for a determinate recipient.
The path-side trapping place supplies the point at which a trajectory is caught.
Crossing a limit in disobedience defines the trajectory and recipient class.
Return to a place turns the focus post into the terminus of that trajectory.

structural_cues: The recipient-and-destination expression in 78:22 directly continues the focus nominal clause rather than beginning an unrelated scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies boundary-crossers, return, and a preassigned focus trap. I infer that the exceeded limit generates a returning trajectory caught at its reserved endpoint. A live alternative is that return merely means destination, without any causal reversal of prior movement.

changed_reading.after: The prepared trap is the reserved return-point for trajectories that crossed their limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Remaining in place, retention, and extended periods convert the focus from a momentary interception site into a capture system whose trap continues as confinement.

activation_trace.role: A prepared trapping place supplies initial capture at the path.
Remaining in a location extends capture into residence.
Retention supplies the holding function of the trap.
Extension across a long period supplies the duration of confinement.

structural_cues: 78:22 establishes destination and 78:23 immediately adds residence and duration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a trap, staying, retention, and extended duration. I infer that the interception mechanism persists as detention rather than ending at entry. A live alternative is that the focus names only the entrance while a separate interior supplies the long stay.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes the instant at which arrivals are intercepted.
changed_reading.after: The focus initiates a capture-and-hold mechanism whose interception becomes prolonged confinement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Matched recompense, equality to a counterpart, accounting, exhaustive enumeration, and binding record activate the focus preparation as calibrated enforcement. The station does not merely catch; it applies an assigned consequence indexed to a complete account.

activation_trace.role: Preparation for recompense supplies an enforcement instrument assigned in advance.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies act-to-outcome correspondence.
A measure equal to its need or counterpart supplies calibration.
Counting and accounting supply the evaluative operation the recipients failed to expect.
Exhaustive numerical enumeration prevents omitted items from escaping the assignment.
A recorded determination that obligates judgment supplies enforceable status to the account.

structural_cues: 78:26 states correspondence, 78:27 names rejected accounting, 78:29 gives the record universal scope, and 78:30 issues the resulting consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompense, equivalence, accounting, exhaustive enumeration, a binding record, and focus preparation. I infer that the prepared station operationalizes the ledger as individualized enforcement. A live alternative is that the record validates the sentence but does not characterize Jahannam's own function.

changed_reading.before: Jahannam is a generally prepared punishment.
changed_reading.after: Jahannam is a calibrated enforcement station where a complete record becomes matching consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Protection and a wilderness image poised between escape and destruction, followed by recompense, giving, and sufficiency, place the focus trap on one arm of a discriminating route system rather than making it every traveler's endpoint.

activation_trace.role: The focus path-post supplies a route at which different outcomes can diverge.
Protection that repels harm supplies the condition for avoiding the perilous arm.
A wilderness poised lexically between salvation and destruction supplies a route contrast to the focus trap.
Recompense answers conduct on the protected side as it did on the punitive side.
Giving and transfer supply the positive outcome opposite enforced capture.
Sufficiency supplies abundance rather than punitive accounting on the protected arm.

structural_cues: The emphatic openings of 78:21 and 78:31 introduce opposed destinations, and both blocks close with recompense language.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus path-post, protection, a route image spanning escape and peril, and positive recompense. I infer a discriminating fork in which Jahannam is the perilous arm. A live alternative is that the parallel blocks contrast destinations without making the focus post itself a selector.

changed_reading.before: The focus trap appears as the only operative destination in the scene.
changed_reading.after: The focus trap is the perilous arm of a bifurcated route, contrasted with protected escape and gift.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sovereignty, controlled address, standing ranks, permission, correct speech, and manifested reality subordinate the focus guard-post to an ordered court. Its watching is administrative and authorized, not an autonomous predatory force.

activation_trace.role: Guarding and watch supply the controlled-access function to be placed under authority.
The lookout station supplies a threshold compatible with court administration.
Sovereignty and rule identify the superior authority over access and outcome.
Reciprocal address supplies the controlled court action that creatures cannot independently command.
Bodily standing supplies formal attendance before authority.
Alignment on a straight rank supplies ordered placement rather than uncontrolled crowding.
Permission restricts who may perform the speech act.
Correctness settled against error supplies a substantive condition on authorized speech.
Stable correspondence with reality confirms the court scene as manifest rather than deceptive.

structural_cues: 78:37 denies independent control of address, 78:38 orders ranks and restricts speech, and 78:39 declares the day real.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sovereignty, restricted address, ranked standing, permission, correct speech, reality, and a guarded focus threshold. I infer that the guard-post executes the court's controlled access. A live alternative is that the speech protocol governs judgment generally while Jahannam remains only a destination.

changed_reading.before: Jahannam behaves like an autonomous ambush.
changed_reading.after: Jahannam functions as an authorized checkpoint within a sovereign and procedurally controlled court.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing warning makes the encounter temporally near, then makes each person inspect what was advanced and acquired by their own hands. The focus's prior waiting and the person's prior advancing form a two-sided convergence at a deed-indexed endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Established temporal presence places the endpoint in readiness before the final encounter.
Waiting and watch supply one side of the convergence.
Advance assignment supplies an endpoint already prepared for what reaches it.
A fear-awakening warning makes the prepared encounter actionable in the present.
Temporal nearness removes indefinite distance from the waiting endpoint.
Directed sight or insight makes the person's prior production inspectable at encounter.
Advancing ahead supplies motion from the actor's past toward the waiting endpoint.
What the hands acquired identifies the advanced material as the actor's own deeds.

structural_cues: 78:40 folds warning, temporal proximity, inspection, and prior action into one closing encounter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a waiting and preassigned focus endpoint, a near warning, inspection, prior advance, and hand-acquisition. I infer that deeds travel ahead to specify the encounter that awaits their actor. A live alternative is that deeds are merely displayed at judgment and do not configure Jahannam's preparation.

changed_reading.before: A one-sided trap waits for people from outside their own history.
changed_reading.after: The waiting endpoint converges with what each person already sent forward, making the trap deed-indexed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The rare rain-and-pasture branch within the focus root is activated by the packet's uninterrupted rain-to-seed-to-garden production chain. This permits a contained ecological inversion: Jahannam as an expectant field prepared to yield a punitive return rather than living growth.

activation_trace.role: First rain, slight pasture, and land made hopeful for growth provide the focus-side expectancy image.
Rain-bearing cloud supplies the source of the productive sequence.
Watering and pouring supply the medium that prepares land for yield.
Abundant pouring supplies intensity to the preparation.
Seed that germinates supplies the first expected yield.
Vegetation emerging from earth makes the yield visible.
A tree-covered garden supplies the mature productive field.
Intertwined growth supplies the chain's abundant culmination.

structural_cues: 78:14-16 form an uninterrupted water-to-growth chain, while the focus inventory independently retains a rain-and-pasture branch for root ر ص د.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a rare focus rain-growth branch and a nearby complete growth sequence. I infer a negative-harvest contrast in which preparation yields punitive return. A live alternative, and the major caution, is that the focus branch is a lexicographic homonym with no contextual role here.

changed_reading.before: The focus is only an ambush prepared to catch entrants.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the focus is also an expectant counter-field prepared to yield a punitive harvest.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a rain-and-pasture branch is distant from the dominant watchpost sense. It remains packet-anchored in word 4 and is unusually activated by the explicit rain, seed, growth, and garden chain of 78:14-16. Downstream prose should label it a branch-level ecological echo or counter-harvest possibility, never the lexical gloss or settled interpretation of the focus.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 4, root ر ص د, through its retained rain, pasture, and hoped-for-growth branch.

activation_trace.role: The rare focus branch supplies land held in expectation of growth.
Watering supplies preparation for yield.
Germinating seed supplies anticipated production.
Emergent vegetation supplies realized growth.
The mature garden supplies the positive endpoint inverted by the outlier.

changed_reading.before: The prepared place only waits to capture.
changed_reading.after: As a contained lexical echo, the prepared place resembles an expectant field whose eventual yield is punitive rather than fertile.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because suretyship is form-distant from the finite focus verb and the debt image metaphorizes punishment. It remains anchored in both focus roots and gains context support from recompense as debt collection in 78:26. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory liability mechanism: Jahannam guarantees collection, not as a direct translation of the clause.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 3, root ك و ن, supplies the surety possibility; word 4, root ر ص د, supplies advance assignment for liability or recompense.

activation_trace.role: Undertaking responsibility supplies the personified guarantor.
Something set aside for debt or recompense supplies the guaranteed liability.
Collection and satisfaction of debt give the focus metaphor a context-local enforcement endpoint.

changed_reading.before: Jahannam is a passive punishment already prepared.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, Jahannam is the standing guarantee that the account's liability will be collected.

strongest_changes: Appointment, separation, and grouped arrival make the focus a timed sorting checkpoint.
The immediate return and duration clauses turn ambush into a reserved capture-and-detention mechanism.
Recompense, equivalence, accounting, exhaustive enumeration, and binding record make preparation calibrated and deed-specific.
The closing near warning and prior hand-acquisition make the waiting endpoint converge with what each person advanced.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah activation linked the focus route image backward to prepared then reversed terrain and forward to return, detention, audit, protected escape, controlled court, and deed encounter. The rare rain-growth branch also produced a contained counter-harvest outlier that a conservative synthesis would likely drop.
remaining_uncertainties: The place and surety branches of root ك و ن are form-distant from the finite focus verb and should not displace its ordinary temporal function.
The context makes sorting and authorized judgment live mechanisms, but it does not settle whether the focus post performs the sorting or receives people after it.
The ecological activation may be only a lexicographic homonym despite its unusually dense local rain-to-growth support.
